mapping.summary: Skills and certification mapping platform with gap analysis and skills-based staffing
claims: Library of industry and technical skills plus thousands of certifications to map against
Shows skill gaps by role, team or skill
Flags capability at risk from attrition, retirement or expiring certificates
Stores certificate proof with expiry reminders and change history for audits
Finds people for projects by skills, certifications and availability
Produces CVs for proposals from live skills data
AI agent answers questions in plain language and returns reports
Microsoft Entra ID single sign-on and user sync
Integrates with Business Central and Power BI
Also integrates with SuccessFactors, Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, Personio and other HR and learning tools
Hosted in the EU and GDPR compliant
